title: Plasma-Light Hybrid Computer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public AI and computing knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. The hybrid computer fuses the two machines: plasma for wave-native physics simulation, annealing, and control; photonics for matrix math, imaging, and communication — coupled so tightly they act as one. The coupling physics is real: plasma modulates light (Faraday rotation, plasma mirrors, and electro-optic effects all link the two), and light drives plasma (laser ionization, optical probes). The hybrid is not two computers side by side; it is one computer with two substrates.

title: Plasma-Light Hybrid Computer — The coupling physics
body: Public edition. Public AI and computing knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. Plasma and light interact in both directions. Light into plasma: lasers ionize gas (laser-induced breakdown is standard), heat electrons, and probe density. Plasma into light: magnetized plasma rotates light polarization (Faraday rotation, a 19th-century discovery), plasma density gradients refract beams, and plasma oscillations modulate transmitted light. These effects are the hybrid's wires: every signal crossing between substrates rides real, characterized physics.

title: Plasma-Light Hybrid Computer — Plasma-driven optical modulators
body: Public edition. Public AI and computing knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. The flagship coupler: a plasma cell whose density directly sets an optical modulator's state. A wave computation in plasma changes the cell's refractive index; a light beam passing through is modulated with zero electronic middleman. Plasma electro-optic modulation is grounded in standard plasma optics — the refractive index of plasma depends on density by the Appleton-Hartree relation's simplest form. Gigabits per second, no transistors involved.

title: Plasma-Light Hybrid Computer — Laser-driven plasma logic
body: Public edition. Public AI and computing knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. The reverse link: shaped laser pulses write directly into plasma — ionizing patterns, launching solitons, imprinting density landscapes. Spatial light modulators shape the laser; the plasma receives a full two-dimensional program in one flash. Laser-plasma interaction is a vast established field (inertial fusion, wakefield acceleration), and the hybrid borrows its tools at gentle, precise settings.

title: Plasma-Light Hybrid Computer — The unified scheduler
body: Public edition. Public AI and computing knowledge, fact-checked reference. Speculative material is absent from this edition; anything not yet established science lives in the Signature twin. One scheduler rules both substrates: it profiles each kernel, estimates its speed on plasma versus photonics (versus electronics, for the control-heavy parts), places it, and manages the coupling links' bandwidth. Scheduling across heterogeneous substrates is an active computer-science field; the hybrid's scheduler is its operating system. Users see one machine with one queue — the substrates are an implementation detail.
